# AnnotateKit

> Cursor-style visual annotation for iOS apps, for coding agents. A DEBUG-only Swift overlay lets a developer freeze their running app, draw on it, tap an element or hold for an exact spot, and comment; Send writes a session bundle (1x screenshots where pixel = point, annotated screens, crops, exact coordinates, nearby visible text, prompt.md, session.json) and the `annotate` CLI delivers it to Claude Code (channels push, MCP tools, watcher skill, or headless `claude -p`) or any MCP client, with progress shown back on the device. Works from the Simulator and from a paired physical device (bundles are copied over `devicectl`, no app setup); a dot on the launcher pill shows whether an agent is listening. Agents can block on `annotation_wait` for hands-free delivery in any MCP client, say which pin they're on with `annotation_acknowledge`, report each pin with `annotation_resolve` / `annotation_dismiss`, and ask the user about a pin with `annotation_ask` (repeat questions on one pin form a thread the device shows); pins carry an intent (fix or question). File formats: SCHEMA.md.

Website: https://annotatekit.com

Swift package: https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit (product `AnnotateKit`, iOS 17+). Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add ooolzhas/annotatekit`, then `/plugin install annotate@annotatekit`. MCP server: `annotate mcp` (stdio), or `npx -y annotate-ios mcp` with nothing installed.

## Using it

- [Setup skill (for agents)](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/skills/annotate-setup/SKILL.md): step-by-step: add the package to any iOS project shape, install the CLI, connect Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / VS Code, verify
- [Watcher skill](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/skills/annotate-watch/SKILL.md): act on each sent session as it arrives
- [README](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/README.md): overview, delivery modes, gestures, bundle layout, prompt example
- [Getting Started (DocC)](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/Sources/AnnotateKit/AnnotateKit.docc/GettingStarted.md)

## Session format

- [session.json types](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/Sources/AnnotateCore/Session.swift): AnnotationSession, Screen, Annotation (element / point / region / sketch), coordinates in points
- [Prompt rendering](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/Sources/AnnotateCore/PromptRenderer.swift)
- [Bundle and status files](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/Sources/AnnotateCore/SessionWriter.swift): status.json states delivered, received, working, done, failed

## MCP tools

- [ChannelServer](https://github.com/ooolzhas/annotatekit/blob/main/Sources/AnnotateAgent/ChannelServer.swift): `get_annotation_session` (prompt + images), `annotation_status` (report back to the device), `list_annotation_sessions`; pushes `notifications/claude/channel`
